[2670]
,MA RIG ‘GAGS PAR GYUR NA NI,
,GANG ZHIG ‘GAG PAR ‘GYUR BA DE,
,MI SHES PA LAS KUN BRTAGS PAR,
,JI LTA BUR NA GSAL MI GYUR,

When misunderstanding
Comes to a stop,
Why wouldn’t those elements
Come to a stop,

Since all the mistaken
Imaginations of failing
To understand things
Were brought to light?


[2671]
ZHES GSUNGS TE, RANG GI NGO BO NYID KYIS GRUB NA GNAS LUGS SU GRUB PAR ‘GYUR LA, DE’I TSE ‘KHRUL PA LOG PA NA GSAL DU ‘GRO DGOS KYI, LDOG PAR MI ‘GYUR RO, ZHES PA’I DON NO,,

The point here is that—if things could exist through some essential nature of their own—then they would exist by the very nature of things.  In that case, if we were able to correct our error, the truth would have to be brought to light.  But in the opposite case, it would not.

Would no longer be
Any karma either.	


[2673]
SEMS GTZO BO YIN PA DE NYID BSTAN PA’I PHYIR BSHAD PA DE LA SEMS CAN GYI ‘JIG RTEN NI RANG GI SEMS KYIS BSAGS PA’I LAS DANG NYON MONGS PAS BDAG GI DNGOS PO RNYED PA YIN LA,

The goal here then is to explain this one thing: that the mind is the principal point.  To do so, we show how the world of living beings is brought into being as something for them through the karma and the negativities that they have accumulated with their own minds.


[2674]
SNOD KYI ‘JIG RTEN SHIN TU SNA TSOGS PA NI SEMS CAN DE DAG KHO NA’I SEMS NYID KYIS BSAGS PA’I THUN MONG BA’I LAS KYIS ‘GOD PA STE SKYED DE, RLUNG GI DKYIL ‘KHOR NAS ‘OG MIN GYI SNOD KYI MTHAR THUG PA’O,,

And the vessel of the outer world, with all its endless variation, is something that has been “set forth”—which is to say, created—only by all these living beings, through the communal karma they have accumulated with nothing other than their own minds.  And this refers to the entire universe, up to its very ends—starting from the disk of wind that serves as the foundation of the universe, up to the highest of its levels, known as “Below None.”


[2675]
DE LA RMA BYA LA SOGS PA’I MDONGS LA SOGS PA SNA TSOGS PA NI, SEMS CAN DE RNAMS KHO NA’I LAS THUN MONG MA YIN PAS SKYED PA’O,,

And so things like the extraordinary variety of colors found in things such as the feathers of the peacock are all objects which were created by the unique karma only of living beings themselves.


[2676]
PAD+MA LA SOGS PA’I ‘DAB MA DANG KHA DOG SNA TSOGS PA NI, SEMS CAN GYI THUN MONG GI LAS KYIS BSKYED PA’O,,

The petals and multifarious hues of things like the lotus too are produced from the shared karma of living beings.

paragraphs.text: Tat kathaṃ nāma na spaṣṭam ajñāna parikalpitam.
Tat kathan nama na spashtam ajnana parikalpitam.
,MI SHES PA LA KUN BRTAGS PAR,
SNANG BA NYE BA NA MUN PA BZHIN DU RIG PA’I YE SHES BYUNG BAS MA RIG PA ‘GAG PAR ‘GYUR BA NA
When wisdom—which does understand things—rises, then misunderstanding comes to a stop; just the way that darkness behaves as dawn approaches.
‘DU BYED LA SOGS PA GANG ZHIG ‘GAG PAR ‘GYUR BA DE MI SHES PA GTI MUG PA LAS KUN BRTAGS PAR JI LTA BUR NA GSAL BAR RTOGS PAR MI ‘GYUR TE,

Why then wouldn’t those elements of fresh karma and the rest come to a stop—why wouldn’t we see them cleared away—when all the mistaken imaginations of failing to understand things, these forms of darkness, were brought to light?
Tat kathaṃ nāma na spaṣṭam ajñāna parikalpitam.
Tat kathan nama na spashtam ajnana parikalpitam.
,MI SHES PA LA KUN BRTAGS PAR,
CHOS CAN MA RIG PAS KUN DU BTAGS PAR THAL, DNGOS PO BDEN ‘DZIN MA RIG PA ‘GAG PA’I STOBS KYIS ‘GAG PAR ‘GYUR BA’I PHYIR,
Isn’t it true to say that it must be a creation of our imagination?
Because when we put a stop to the misunderstanding which holds things to be real, it also comes to a stop.
Tat kathaṃ nāma na spaṣṭam ajñāna parikalpitam.
Tat kathan nama na spashtam ajnana parikalpitam.
,MI SHES PA LAS KUN BRTAGS PAR,
